info.name: GAS-FSM PostgREST API
info.description:
Field Service Management API for gas installation, maintenance, and certification.

**Stack**: PostgreSQL 16 + PostGIS 3.5 + PostgREST 12
**Mode**: Single-tenant, JWT auth via Go backend (F6 pending)

## Quick Start
1. Select environment: GAS-FSM-dev
2. Run "Auth: Generate JWT" folder
3. Start querying endpoints

## Auth
JWT is generated via pre-request script using PGRST_JWT_SECRET.
Token is cached in jwt_token variable and auto-refreshed on expiry.

item.name: Generate JWT (dev)
item.description: Generates a new JWT token using PGRST_JWT_SECRET from environment. Token is cached and auto-refreshed.
